title: Most mental events are caused by brain events, and some by other mental events

statements.text: Most pure mental events, especially passive ones such as sensations, thoughts, beliefs and desires, are caused at least in part by brain events, as a toothache by tooth decay. Some mental events are caused in part by other mental events, as a thought that something is the answer to a mathematical problem is caused in part by other mathematical thoughts.

sources.quote: I do not of course deny that most of my pure mental events are caused by my brain events.
plausibly often a thought that such-and-such is the answer to a mathematical problem is caused in part by thoughts that certain other mathematical propositions are true
